candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (and /readyz), causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 propagating through order to gateway; payment logs confirm repeated 503s on /v1/authorizations.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, dependency, or crash) not established; payment metrics excluded from context. Inventory/redis path is healthy.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations. Payment logs show sustained 503s. Inventory reservations succeed (200), so the fault is bounded to the payment dependency. Exact payment failure mechanism remains unconfirmed.
